_about: EFFECT: pop-up-variety-caption. A plan for lib/variety-captions/vc.py (variety-show captions: tag, name card, sweat, pop words, burst with a punch-in, stamp). Footage: NASA, 'NASA Astronaut Discusses Life in Space with New Hampshire Students', Sept. 24, 2026 (images.nasa.gov, iss075m262671538; public domain), cut 240–264.5 s. To make your own: transcribe your clip with word times (faster-whisper), replace subs/words and the captions on your own moments, keep the kinds, sizes and pacing; render with vc.py render --footage your.mp4 --plan this.json --out out.mp4.
subs: Well, Emory, I'm not so great at gymnastics on earth.
So on the space station, I'm a lot better.
I can do flips like this.
And I would never be able to do that on earth
though some people can because they practice a lot.
And I can fly as well.
I can't do that on earth.
